answer: Grant each identity a quota that grows only glacier-slowly with verified useful work, so a fresh account can barely transact while a long-lived one reaches the summit of trust. A public random beacon then audits a sample each week, demanding fresh proof of the same work history and live control; identities that fail lose their quota and standing. An attacker can mint thousands of shells, but each must still wait months of real work to matter, and bulk creation only multiplies that waiting cost without multiplying influence.
